title: Project Intelligence API Contracts
description: Reusable schemas for the repository intelligence, probe planning, validation, and experiment APIs.

SourceMetadata.description: Author-written, source-anchored explanation copied verbatim from a docstring probe-agent block. Kept separate from reasoning-model output; origin is always source_authored.

explanation_hash.description: sha256 of the extracted explanation block. A change signal only; not semantic equality.

ExplanationAnchor.description: A deterministic source anchor an explanation depends on (file, symbol span, and hash provenance). Used by downstream drift features; hash equality is only a change signal.

file_content_hash.description: sha256 of the committed file content for the symbol's path in the pinned snapshot.

symbol_source_hash.description: sha256 of the symbol's exact source span (signature + body, as committed).

symbol_body_hash.description: sha256 of a normalized AST with docstring removed and comments/formatting excluded.

HierarchyProvenance.description: Provenance for a single capability-hierarchy claim. provenance_kind distinguishes source-authored explanation, deterministic structural fact, and reasoning interpretation; decision_method is the audit enum.

DriftCounts.description: Drift dependency counts and ratios for a capability/system. Hash drift is a review trigger, not a correctness verdict.

ApiRoleCard.description: Flow Explorer developer context for one backend entrypoint (Issue #58). Aggregates source-authored explanation (#54), hierarchy placement (#56), and drift (#57). Joins to FlowEntrypoint by (entrypoint_type, entrypoint_id).

ExplanationRefreshProposal.description: A reviewable, reasoning-model suggestion to refresh a drifted source-backed explanation (Issue #59). A SUGGESTION only: probe-agent never edits the target source repository; a developer applies it by hand.

InterviewProposalMetadataBlock.description: Proposed probe-agent: docstring metadata block for a single symbol (Issue #67). Finite fields (element_type, operation_kind, state_effects) use #54's vocabulary; role/capability/system_purpose/probe_value are free text per #54. This is an LLM-authored proposal, not a source_authored extraction, so it carries no origin/explanation_hash.

InterviewProposalProbePlan.description: Proposed probe-plan fields for the same symbol (Issue #25 model). Mirrors ProbePoint's finite vocabularies.

InterviewCombinedProposal.description: Combined per-symbol proposal payload for the system-understanding interview (Issue #67): the proposed probe-agent: docstring metadata block AND the associated probe plan for one symbol, kept consistent with #54's vocabulary and #25's probe-plan fields.

InterviewProposal.description: A persisted interview proposal row (Issue #67). Wraps the combined payload with identifiers, the reasoning-run audit link, decision_method, and per-item approval state. decision_method is reasoning_llm for newly stored proposals; manual is set only by the later approval issue.

understanding_confirmed_at.description: Issue #123: timestamp of the developer's manual confirmation that the interview gathered enough context; unlocks the proposal gate when no structured understanding could be built (zero-base fallback).

capability_graph_confirmed_revision_id.description: Issue #312: latest Understanding revision manually confirmed into the canonical Capability graph for this session.

capability_graph_confirmation_required.description: Issue #312: true when the latest structured Understanding revision still requires human Capability graph confirmation.

answers_revised_at.description: Issue #129: set when an interview_qa answer is corrected; cleared only by a successful understanding rebuild, never automatically by the revision itself. Drives the dashboard's rebuild-recommended banner.

understanding_update_available.description: Issue #229/#263: deterministic mirror of the update-understanding 409 gate (single source of truth shared with the API check). False only in proposal_generation, after manual confirmation, with no answer correction and no interview_qa row created/answered since confirmation.

InterviewEvidenceLocation.description: Snapshot-relative evidence location resolvable against the pinned snapshot (Issue #68).

InterviewSymbolItem.description: A symbol from the pinned snapshot's index, with classification status and any existing metadata (Issue #68).

InterviewEntrypointItem.description: A discovered entrypoint from the pinned snapshot, with classification status (Issue #68).

InterviewContextPack.description: Deterministic, no-LLM interview context pack assembled from a pinned snapshot (Issue #68). Contains symbols and entrypoints with classification status and evidence locations, within an explicit LLM context budget.

InterviewDialogueTurnRequest.description: Request body for a single interview dialogue turn (Issue #69). generate_proposals gates proposal output (Issue #83); answered_question lets the server consume the open question the user just answered (Issue #123), superseded by answered_qa_id (Issue #129) but still honored during the migration period.

InterviewDialogueProposalOut.description: A single combined proposal from a dialogue turn (Issue #69), before persistence.

InterviewQuestionEvidenceRef.description: Snapshot-relative code reference backing an interview question (Issue #128). Validated deterministically against the context pack / stored understanding before the turn is accepted.

InterviewStructuredQuestion.description: Hypothesis-first interview question (Issue #128): the model states its working hypothesis with evidence, then asks a focused confirmation question. answer_options offer quick replies when the realistic answers form a small set.

InterviewDialogueTurnOut.description: Response from a single interview dialogue turn (Issue #69). If error is set, the turn failed closed and no proposals were stored. next_questions are structured hypothesis-first questions since Issue #128 (schema interview-v2). created_qa_ids/evidence_run/evidence_used are Issue #129/#130 additions. proposals_requested reports whether this turn asked the reasoning model for proposals (generate_proposals with the stage/understanding gate open); when true with an empty proposals list, the model returned narrowing questions in next_questions instead — a requested turn that returns neither fails closed.

IntelligenceRunEvidence.description: One snippet actually read from the pinned snapshot during pass 1 of the interview dialogue turn (Issue #137), regardless of whether the resulting question cited it. Snippet content itself is never persisted.

InterviewQaEvidenceRef.description: Snapshot-relative code reference for a Q&A row, optionally with what was actually read (Issue #130's char_count).

InterviewQA.description: A structured interview question/answer row (Issue #129). Correcting an answer never overwrites this row: a new row is inserted with the correction and this row is marked 'revised' with superseded_by_id set to the new row's id. Status 'unconfirmed' (Issue #142) records that the developer explicitly could not confirm the answer ('I don't know'); such rows are valid input, not errors, and are fed back to the reasoning model as open hypotheses to re-confirm, never as established facts.

InterviewQaAnswerOut.description: Result of answering or correcting a question (Issue #129). regeneration_recommended is set (never acted on automatically) when the session already has generated proposals.

UnderstandingRevision.description: One appended (never overwritten) understanding snapshot from a successful update-understanding call (Issue #136), linked to the understanding_review intelligence_runs row that produced it.

UnderstandingDiff.description: Deterministic structural diff between two understanding revisions, matched by exact item name only (Issue #136). has_previous=false means there is no earlier revision to compare against (e.g. the session's first revision); sections is then empty rather than an all-added diff.

RuntimeTraceFacts.description: Deterministic trace aggregates for one component_id over a window (Issue #135). has_traces=false with null numeric fields is the '0 traces for an approved probe plan' signal; whether that is worth a question is decided by the reasoning step, never here.

RuntimeRealityCheckItem.description: One approved element's declared understanding paired with its runtime trace facts (Issue #135).

RuntimeRealityFacts.description: Response for the deterministic-only runtime facts endpoint (no reasoning model call, Issue #135).

RuntimeRealityCheckRun.description: Response for triggering the Runtime Reality Check reasoning run (Issue #135). skipped=true means generation was suppressed because unanswered runtime questions already exist for this session; no intelligence_runs row is created in that case.

InterviewProposalDecision.description: A persisted manual decision on a proposal (Issue #70). Each decision references — but does not overwrite — the original reasoning_llm proposal.

InterviewApprovedItem.description: An item from the approved set, ready for materialization (Issue #70). Contains the effective values: edited if decision was 'edited', original if 'approved'.

InterviewApprovedSet.description: The approved set for a session: items eligible for materialization (Issue #70).

InterviewMaterializeResult.description: Result of materializing approved proposals into a reviewable diff (Issue #71).
